title: Nice idea
text: Nice idea. This is a good idea however it is difficult to keep in place - you need someone to hold up the mattress (if you have a heavy one like me) so that you can slip the section between the mattress and the box spring.  Nice compartments but that section which goes between the mattress and box spring should be made from a firmer material.

product_metadata.title: Richards Homewares Gearbox Bedside Caddy (65643)
features: Easily slides between mattress and box spring
description: Ideal for a dorm room that is too small, equipped with 3 deep pockets and 3 mesh pockets to hold it all. Heavy weight 600 denier polyester is plenty durable to be your bedside organizer.
